objective: Review and coordinate implementation of the P0-P4 automation roadmap for Checkout Workbench.

roles.assignment: Own state-machine shape, P0-P4 sequencing, next_action semantics, and final decision records.
Review backend/CDP feasibility for readiness gates, PIN contexts, GoPay token lifecycle, and audit fields.
Review frontend orchestration, status lights, manual handoff, and user-visible workflow clarity.
Review operator burden, recovery paths, runbook clarity, and payment safety visibility.

acceptance_criteria: Plus probe no-progress loops are bounded.
GoPay CDP polling is gated on target readiness.
GoPay expired/not_found/rate_limited token states are not retried blindly.
PIN input source can distinguish automation_synthetic from user_trusted_event.
Operator UI exposes current state, blocker, and next action.
Pay now is never clicked repeatedly by automation.
